title: Cohort baseline & auto-probe generator for embedding+reranker regression detection
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Recent rollout cadence for model variants and config-driven reranker heuristics has increased the number of prod-facing changes. Existing regression detectors focus either on token-level language generation or simple embedding drift; we lack a lightweight, automated offline pipeline that (1) computes cohort-specific baselines for recall/precision/MRR for embed+rerank flows and (2) auto-generates synthetic probes and statistical checks to catch regressions introduced by model or config changes before canarying to traffic.

Goal: Build an offline cohort-baselining and auto-probe generator service that runs as part of pre-deploy CI and nightly backfills. The service should produce a per-change delta report (recall@k, precision@1, MRR, embedding-cosine-distribution shift z-score) and surface a confidence-weighted regression score. It should integrate with the existing eval harness and create alerts and rollback suggestions when thresholds are exceeded.

Scope:
- Cohort definition: support shard keys (customer, product_type, query-length-buckets, time-window) and derived cohorts (high-variance queries).
- Baseline computation: store historical metrics for each cohort and provide stable baselines with percentiles and variance estimates.
- Probe generation: auto-create synthetic perturbations (query paraphrases, noise-injection, ID-swaps) and sample negative examples to stress reranker precision.
- Statistical checks: paired test for metric deltas, KS test for embedding distribution shift, and bootstrapped confidence intervals.
- CI integration: a lightweight check that can block merges if a change produces a high-confidence regression for a critical cohort.
- Nightly backfill: run full baseline recomputation weekly and keep 90d of cohort history for trending.

Non-goals: full production alerting on live traffic (observability/alerting integration will be a follow-up), end-user facing dashboard (we will surface results in a console view later).
acceptance_criteria: Offline job computes baseline metrics for at least 5 curated cohorts and stores results in S3 with stable schema
Auto-probe generator emits at least 3 synthetic probe types per cohort and these probes are runnable by the eval harness
CI check runs in <3 minutes for typical changes and flags failures when delta(recall@10) drops by >3% with p<0.01
Nightly backfill completes within scheduled window and produces a regression report linked to the change id
Generated reports include numeric deltas, confidence intervals, KS z-score for embedding shift, and suggested rollback severity (none|soft|hard)
plan: Design data schema for cohort baselines and probe manifests (drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-baseline-spec)
Prototype probe generator (paraphrase/noise/id-swap) as a Py module and add unit tests
Extend eval harness to accept probe manifests and return standardized metric bundles
Implement offline job: trigger on PR/merge with changed model/config fingerprint and on nightly cron
Add CI gating step with fast-sample mode and Slack/Console notification integration
Backfill historical data for curated cohorts (approx 90M queries) using Spark job and validate baselines
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: False positives from small cohorts -> Mitigation: require minimum sample size and use bootstrapped CIs
Risk: Probe generator may not reflect real production failures -> Mitigation: iterate with PM/SE on probe rules and add replay of recent regression incidents as seeds
Risk: CI runtime too long -> Mitigation: implement fast-sample mode and require full-run only on nightly/backfill
Risk: Storage / cost for cohort history -> Mitigation: compress metrics, use 90d retention and aggregate older history into monthly summaries
